name: Floating Library of Planets
description: A magical library where each book floats like a planet, orbiting around central reading nooks, with pages that swirl like nebulae.
prompt: Elegant library with books levitating like planets, each book's pages swirling into nebular patterns, central reading areas with warm lamplight, soft shadows, photorealistic, no text, serene scholarly wonder.
caption: Browse a cosmos of books—each volume is a planet waiting to be explored and read.
